subject: Adds workflows to build release binaries and push to S3 (#315)
reason: The change adds GitHub Actions workflows and a release-tools build matrix config to build release binaries and push them to S3. It modifies only CI/packaging files (.github/actions/generate-package-build-matrix, .github/workflows/build-release-packages.yml, call-build-linux-{arm,x86}-packages.yml, utils/releasetools/build-config.json) and no server, tool, or client code, so there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
